Group rides in Portland, ME

7 recurring group rides around Portland, ME: 3 road, 3 social, 1 mountain bike. 5 roll on weeknights, 1 on weekends. New to group rides? Start with Mellow Monday Ride in Portland — it's no-drop, nobody gets left. Want to go fast? Portland Velo Club Wednesday Night Ride runs a 20–26 mph no waiting; B group behind.

I do the miles. You decide who they’re for.
